exercises.question: Which sentence correctly reports speech? [¿Cuál transmite correctamente el discurso?]
options: Ana dijo que estaba ocupada. [Ana said that she was busy.]
Ana dijo si estaba ocupada. [Ana said if she was busy.]
Ana dijo estaba ocupada. [Ana said was busy.]

exercises.sentence: Me preguntó __ tenía tiempo. (si) [She asked me if I had time.]

exercises.english: He meant that he needed more time.

sentences: No entendí la instrucción. [I did not understand the instruction.]
Pedí que me lo explicara. [I asked her to explain it to me.]
No entendí la instrucción y pedí que me lo explicara. [I did not understand the instruction and asked her to explain it to me.]

exercises.question: Which expression asks for clarification? [¿Cuál pide una aclaración?]
options: ¿Qué quieres decir exactamente? [What exactly do you mean?]
¿Qué hiciste ayer? [What did you do yesterday?]
¿Dónde vives? [Where do you live?]

exercises.sentence: Fue un __ bastante incómodo. (malentendido) [It was quite an awkward misunderstanding.]

exercises.english: What I mean is that we need to talk.

exercises.question: Which sentence best integrates the unit? [¿Cuál integra mejor la unidad?]
options: Pensé que estaba enfadada, pero explicó lo que quería decir y aclaramos el malentendido. [I thought she was angry, but she explained what she meant and we clarified the misunderstanding.]
Hablamos. [We spoke.]
El mensaje existe. [The message exists.]

exercises.sentence: Según ella, el mensaje era diferente.
options: According to her, the message was different.
According to her, the message was tomorrow.
She asked whether the message was different.

exercises.sentence: Ahora entiendo lo que querías decir.
options: Now I understand what you meant.
Now I understand what you will mean tomorrow.
Now I do not understand what you meant.
Quiso decir que no estaba de acuerdo. [He meant that he did not agree.]
Quiso decir si no estaba de acuerdo. [He meant whether he did not agree.]
Quiso decir con no estaba de acuerdo. [He meant with he did not agree.]
Hablamos directamente y aclaramos el malentendido. [We spoke directly and clarified the misunderstanding.]
Resolvíamos mañana. [We used to resolve tomorrow.]
No aclaramos nada porque hablamos. [We clarified nothing because we spoke.]
Significa explicar las cosas y preguntar cuando algo no está claro. [It means explaining things and asking when something is not clear.]
Significa no preguntar nunca. [It means never asking.]
Significará ayer. [It will mean yesterday.]

exercises.question: Which statement best distinguishes meaning from interpretation? [¿Cuál distingue mejor significado e interpretación?]
options: El mensaje parecía negativo, pero la intención era diferente. [The message seemed negative, but the intention was different.]
El mensaje era negativo porque parecía negativo. [The message was negative because it seemed negative.]
La intención y la interpretación siempre son iguales. [Intention and interpretation are always the same.]

template.prompt: Report something someone said and explain its meaning.
template.answer: Ana dijo que estaba ocupada, pero quiso decir que no podía venir.

template.prompt: Describe how to resolve a misunderstanding.
template.answer: Lo mejor es preguntar directamente, explicar la intención y aclarar cualquier problema.
